deck: COP31 stalls past Day 13 · BepiColombo enters Mercury orbit · Five missiles downed over Saudi Arabia · Drones hit a Russian ship

stats.label: COP31 talks past close, no deal

hero.headline: COP31 runs into overtime with no climate deal
hero.summary: Due to end Friday, the UN summit stayed deadlocked on fossil-fuel text and climate finance; the EU vowed no deal over a bad deal. (BBC, AP News)

hero.headline: BepiColombo enters orbit around Mercury
hero.summary: After an 8-year, 10-billion-km voyage, ESA and JAXA's twin orbiters completed capture — only the second mission to orbit Mercury. (ESA, Space.com)

hero.headline: Coalition says five Houthi missiles downed
hero.summary: Alerts woke Riyadh early Saturday; the Saudi-led coalition reported downing three ballistic missiles over the capital and two over Jizan. (Arab News, AFP)

cards.headline: Drones set Russian cargo ship ablaze
cards.summary: Crew evacuates burning Russia-bound vessel in Gulf of Finland. (Reuters, BBC)

cards.headline: Mexico holds cartel chief Meza Flores
cards.summary: FBI Most Wanted "El Chapo Isidro" held in shoot-out; US alert. (BBC)

cards.headline: Deep M6.8 quake shakes Banda Sea
cards.summary: 132 km tremor off Timor-Leste felt in Darwin; no tsunami. (USGS)

cards.headline: Funeral boat capsizes in southern Nigeria
cards.summary: At least 24 killed after wooden vessel overturns in Bayelsa. (AP)

cards.headline: Air Niugini 767 lands on fire alert
cards.summary: HK–PNG flight diverts past midnight; all 146 exit unhurt. (ABS-CBN)

cards.headline: FBI probes data hack; SEC eyes Nvidia
cards.summary: Bureau probes breach; NYT reports SEC Nvidia accounting probe. (BBC, NYT)

cards.headline: Bitcoin hits 2-yr low then rebounds
cards.summary: Drops below $57k ($2.4B wiped) before rallying past $60k. (CoinDesk)

cards.headline: Rahul's 136 lifts India 118 runs ahead
cards.summary: First Indian opener with tons in all 4 SENA nations; Gill 98. (NDTV)

cards.headline: Bahrain site ablaze; Iran claims drone
cards.summary: Manama blames Iran for plant fire; IRGC claims MQ-9 downed. (AJ)

cards.headline: EU and Indonesia sign free-trade pact
cards.summary: Landmark deal lowers tariffs; EU plastic-export ban begins. (DW, EU)

cards.headline: WHO tracks DRC Ebola; neighbours clear
cards.summary: Agency tracks Bundibugyo cases; Kenya & Nigeria report zero. (WHO)

cards.headline: Alcaraz & Zverev reach ATP Finals decider
cards.summary: Alcaraz tops Shelton in 3 sets; Zverev beats Medvedev 7–6, 6–4. (ATP)

date_check_bullets: Fri 20 Nov: Wall Street AI correction (Nasdaq -5.3%); Russian missiles in Poland; UK–EU reset summit; Bayer $7.25B Roundup approval; US Penny Act.
Thu 19 Nov: ICJ Myanmar genocide ruling; Trump–Xi–Putin Shenzhen declaration.
Wed 18 Nov: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth.
